test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Four activities have been listed, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Jog, Walk, and Run is a type of exercise done with the help of legs.

Whereas,

'Exercise' is a common term used for all types of activities done keep oneself fit.

Hence, Exercise is the odd one.
